haiku_billing.tier_selection: Each response: input plus cache creation plus cache read tokens greater than 100,000 uses the higher tier.

haiku-xhigh.residual_note: Xhigh CLI aggregate retains 387 more output tokens than native records. All input and cache totals agree. Main cost uses CLI total; residual has no invented role or time attribution.

luna_medium_billing.long_context_rule: Above 272000 input tokens, including cached input: double input/cache prices and 1.5 times output prices.
luna_medium_billing.deduplication: Last token_usage_record for each response_id across implementing agent and all independent reviewers.

astra_medium_billing.long_context_rule: Above 272000 input tokens including cache: double input/cache prices and 1.5 times output prices. Reasoning is part of output, not charged twice.
astra_medium_billing.deduplication: Last native token_usage_record per response_id across all five isolated sessions.
astra_medium_billing.basis: API-equivalent of recorded usage; not an invoice or a measurement of subscription quota.
astra_medium_billing.phase_basis: All-agent recorded costs by response completion timestamp; nonoverlapping measured invocation windows split at native code-review, source-review and correction-worker endpoints. Human-answer waiting is excluded; native evidence follow-up and launcher time remain in coordination/final stages. Role costs are separately summed by native session identity. No estimated recovery time deducted.

stages.phase: correction after last review and incomplete report

stage_accounting: Original elapsed stages include roughly 26 seconds of answer pauses for Astra and 42 for Sol; review answer recording can continue afterward. Haiku and Luna medium stages intersect native intervals with active invocations, exclude answer waiting, and separately retain launcher startup/shutdown time. Astra 6 medium partitions its two measured invocations at native code-review, source-review and correction-worker endpoints, assigning each recorded response once by completion timestamp. Its answer pause is excluded, and native evidence follow-up plus launcher time stay inside the measured coordination/final stages. Role costs are separately summed by session. The stages array retains original costs and reconciles to each original run total. The phase-cost chart uses the separate sonnet_current_pricing.stages recalculation for Sonnet; the role and individual-stage tables show both current and original amounts. Time is unchanged. Neuralwatt role costs join explicit client agent/session headers to actual provider billing IDs through SDK log IDs. Stage costs assign reviewer requests to their review round and implementer requests by provider created_at timestamp. Native review intervals define stage boundaries; stage time intersects each invocation’s observed client timestamps, excluding pauses. Unlocated launcher overhead below 0.4 seconds per run is retained separately. Costs and active minutes reconcile to original full-run totals. See neuralwatt_phase_accounting for exact decimal amounts, coverage and limitations.

human_cost_scenario.formula: net saving = assumed human minutes saved * hourly human cost / 60 - (alternative AI cost - baseline AI cost)
human_cost_scenario.assumptions: Equally useful results; human time savings supplied by the reader, not measured; shared human work cancels out. Background agent runtime is not automatically human work.

fast_estimates.status: Conditional, not measured Fast runs; same token usage, logical work and quality assumed.
fast_estimates.speed_evidence: Desktop UI screenshots; written documentation does not specify a Luna-specific numeric multiplier.
fast_estimates.timing_formula: recorded active minutes - attributed model minutes / 3; overlap counted once; tools, tests, summarization and unattributed time fixed.
fast_estimates.range_note: Two attribution choices, not confidence intervals; real timings can fall outside the range.

evidence_limits: Contains exported values and selected outcomes, not raw session logs, prompts, private reasoning or a complete reproduction package. The original model-authored PR descriptions predate the later checks.
